throughline.zh: 亞力披露配電設備在手訂單，YTL 說明柔佛機房代管服務，台灣供應鏈則有南寶膠材供貨及立碁光收發模組送樣的消息。
throughline.en: Allis disclosed a power equipment backlog and YTL detailed its Johor colocation services, while disclosures and reporting in Taiwan covered semiconductor adhesive shipments and optical transceiver sampling.

title.zh: 亞力揭露在手訂單達 130 億元，涵蓋半導體、資料中心與台電設備需求
title.en: Allis Electric reports NT$13 billion backlog across chip, data center and utility markets

summary.zh: 台灣電力設備商亞力 11 月 20 日在線上法說會表示，在手訂單達新台幣 130 億元，並點出台灣、美國及新加坡為主要半導體訂單來源。公司也提到資料中心及台電電網需求，未拆分各市場的訂單金額。
summary.en: Taiwanese electrical equipment supplier Allis Electric reported a NT$13 billion backlog at its November 20 online investor briefing, naming Taiwan, the U.S. and Singapore as its main semiconductor order markets. It also cited data centers and Taipower grid work, without breaking out orders by market.

text.zh: 亞力供應配電盤、變壓器等設備，法說簡報將台積電、聯電、美光等列在高科技客戶名單，並將半導體廠、資料中心和公用電力工程列為不同應用。名單未列個別客戶的在手訂單。
text.en: Allis supplies switchgear and transformers. Its presentation lists TSMC, UMC and Micron among its high-tech customers and identifies fabs, data centers and utility projects as distinct applications. It does not give customer-level backlogs.

text.zh: 經濟日報引述亞力在法說會披露在手訂單總額。工商時報另引述公司指出，近期已接獲電信和電子業者約 15 億元的機房相關訂單。
text.en: Economic Daily News reported the total backlog from the briefing. Commercial Times separately quoted Allis as saying it had received about NT$1.5 billion in data center-related orders from telecom and electronics companies.

text.zh: 公司未公布各類訂單的交付與驗收時程，也未交代約 15 億元的機房相關訂單在總在手訂單中的認列範圍。
text.en: Allis did not give delivery and acceptance schedules by segment or specify how the NT$1.5 billion in data center-related orders was counted in the total backlog.

title.zh: 追蹤｜YTL 電力稱柔佛機房代管服務不受美國遠端算力新規影響
title.en: Follow-up: YTL Power says Johor colocation is unaffected by new U.S. remote compute rule

summary.zh: 馬來西亞 YTL 電力於 11 月 20 日表示，其柔佛資料中心提供機房空間、供電、冷卻和連線，並稱這項代管服務不受美國遠端使用先進晶片新規影響。公司也否認協助轉運 NVIDIA GPU 的指控；上述說法來自公司聲明。
summary.en: Malaysian operator YTL Power said on November 20 that its Johor colocation business supplies space, power, cooling and connectivity and is unaffected by the new U.S. rule on remote access to advanced chips. YTL also denied allegations that it facilitated the transfer of NVIDIA GPUs.

text.zh: YTL 表示柔佛機房為多家全球客戶提供代管服務，包括美國大型雲端業者。美國工業暨安全局在 11 月 19 日刊登臨時最終規則，內容涉及境外資料中心在特定條件下提供先進晶片遠端運算。
text.en: YTL says its Johor sites provide colocation to multiple global customers, including U.S. hyperscalers. The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security published an interim final rule on November 19 covering specified circumstances involving remote use of advanced chips at overseas data centers.

text.zh: YTL 在 11 月 20 日聲明中表示，已就資料中心開發與馬來西亞投資、貿易及工業部合作，並遵守其所適用的申報和進口要求。馬新社報導了公司回應，翌日馬來西亞科技媒體 SoyaCincau 也報導該聲明。
text.en: In its November 20 statement, YTL said it had worked with Malaysia’s trade ministry on its data centers and met applicable reporting and import requirements. Bernama covered the response, followed by Malaysian technology outlet SoyaCincau on November 21.

text.zh: 聲明未列出涉事客戶所用硬體、存取權限或許可文件，公開資料也未見主管機關對相關個案作出認定。
text.en: The statement did not identify hardware, access rights or licenses for individual customers, and no case-specific regulatory finding was located.

title.zh: 南寶披露已供應半導體用膠，另成立部門布局封裝與銅箔基板材料
title.en: Nan Pao reports semiconductor adhesive shipments and a new unit for packaging and laminate materials

summary.zh: 南寶樹脂 11 月 20 日於台灣線上法說會表示，半導體用膠已開始供貨，並已成立半導體產業發展部，涵蓋半導體、光電與銅箔基板材料。公司將先進封裝相關膠材列為拓展目標，未公布該類產品的認證或供貨規模。
summary.en: Taiwanese materials maker Nan Pao said at its November 20 online briefing that it had started shipping semiconductor adhesives and set up a division for semiconductor, optoelectronic and copper-clad laminate materials. It listed advanced packaging adhesives as a development target and gave no qualification or shipment figures for that product class.

text.zh: 經濟日報引述南寶說明，公司與新應材、信紘科成立新寶紘科技開發封裝用膠帶，由南寶供應接著劑。公司也把環氧樹脂及硬化劑列為高階銅箔基板材料的開發基礎。
text.en: Economic Daily News reported that Nan Pao formed a packaging tape venture with Advanced Echem Materials and Trusval Technology, with Nan Pao supplying the adhesive. The company also cited epoxy resins and curing agents as the basis for work on advanced copper-clad laminate materials.

text.zh: 南寶法說簡報列示第三季合併營收 69.25 億元，年增 17%；毛利 21.59 億元，毛利率 31.2%，上年同期為 33.9%。營業利益 10.09 億元，年增 5%；營業利益率從上年同期 16.3% 降至 14.6%。第三季歸屬母公司淨利為 6.56 億元，每股盈餘 5.44 元；前三季分別為 23.23 億元及 19.27 元。
text.en: Nan Pao’s presentation showed Q3 consolidated revenue of NT$6.925 billion, up 17% year over year. Gross profit was NT$2.159 billion and gross margin was 31.2%, down from 33.9% a year earlier. Operating income rose 5% to NT$1.009 billion and operating margin fell from 16.3% to 14.6%. Attributable net income was NT$656 million and EPS was NT$5.44 for the quarter, and NT$2.323 billion and NT$19.27 for the first nine months.

text.zh: 公司未揭露已供貨半導體用膠的客戶、料號、出貨量及應用製程；財務數字是公司整體實績。
text.en: Nan Pao did not disclose customers, product identifiers, volumes or process applications for the adhesives it is shipping. The financial results are company-wide.

title.zh: 追蹤｜經濟日報報導立碁 1.6T 光收發模組已進入客戶送樣驗證
title.en: Follow-up: Economic Daily News reports Ligitek’s 1.6 Tbps module has reached customer sampling

summary.zh: 經濟日報 11 月 22 日報導，台灣立碁的 1.6T 矽光子光收發模組已進入客戶送樣驗證。立碁 9 月曾公布樣品完成及後續送驗規劃，這次報導未指明實際送樣日期或驗證結果。
summary.en: Economic Daily News reported on November 22 that Taiwanese supplier Ligitek’s 1.6 Tbps silicon photonics transceiver had entered customer sampling for qualification. In September, Ligitek had already disclosed a completed sample and plans to submit it. The latest report gave no shipment date or qualification result.

text.zh: 立碁 9 月在公司網站刊載董事長童義興的說明，指出當時已完成樣品，後續規劃送交包括伺服器業者在內的潛在客戶驗證。
text.en: Ligitek’s September website item quoted chair Tung Yi-hsing as saying the sample was complete and identifying server companies among the prospective customers for qualification.

text.zh: 11 月 22 日報導把進度描述為已進入客戶送樣驗證，並提到無塵室設備預計年底陸續到位。1.6T 是傳輸規格，報導未提供測試結果。
text.en: The November 22 report described the project as having reached customer sampling and said cleanroom equipment was expected to begin arriving by year-end. The 1.6 Tbps figure is a transmission specification. No test results were disclosed.

text.zh: 公開資料未確認客戶名稱、送樣時間、合格率、量產訂單或設備實際進場情形。
text.en: Customer names, sample shipment dates, pass rates, volume orders and actual equipment installation remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 環境部提出跨境循環材料合作方向，說明台灣資源循環雙法改革
title.en: Taiwan environment ministry outlines cross-border recycled materials cooperation and legislative reforms

summary.zh: 台灣環境部 11 月 21 日回應 COP31 的零廢棄倡議，表示將與國際夥伴推動循環材料應用及跨境供應鏈合作。環境部說明，台灣今年推動的兩項法制改革涵蓋產品設計、使用及回收，當日未公布新增合作案。
summary.en: On November 21, Taiwan’s environment ministry responded to the COP31 zero-waste initiative by outlining plans to work with international partners on recycled materials and cross-border supply chains. It highlighted two legislative reforms spanning product design, use and recycling, without announcing a new project.

text.zh: 環境部表示，2026 年推動《資源循環推動法》及《廢棄物清理法》雙法改革，管理範圍涵蓋產品設計、材料選擇、使用和回收。
text.en: The ministry said its 2026 reforms involve resource circulation and waste legislation, covering product design, material choices, use and recycling.

text.zh: 環境部將再生材料、資源使用效率及跨產業合作列為工作方向；中央社也報導這項政策說明。
text.en: The ministry set out work on recycled materials, resource efficiency and cross-industry cooperation. CNA also reported the ministry’s position.

text.zh: 聲明未公布新增跨境合作對象、工業材料的再生含量門檻或實施日期。
text.en: The statement gave no new cross-border partners, industrial recycled-content thresholds or effective dates.

name.zh: 環境部 · COP31 與資源循環政策說明
name.en: Environment ministry · COP31 and resource circulation statement

name.zh: 中央社 · 跨境循環材料政策報導

industries.zh: 材料；工廠；資源回收政策

chain.zh: 再生材料至產品設計、工廠使用與回收
chain.en: Recycled materials to product design, factory use and recycling

investment.en: No new investment amount was disclosed.

demand.en: No new order volume was disclosed.

fdi.en: No new foreign investment amount was disclosed.

relevance.zh: 環境部表示，2026 年推動《資源循環推動法》及《廢棄物清理法》雙法改革，管理範圍涵蓋產品設計、材料選擇、使用和回收。
relevance.en: The ministry said its 2026 reforms involve resource circulation and waste legislation, covering product design, material choices, use and recycling.

timing.zh: 環境部聲明於 11 月 21 日發布。
timing.en: The ministry issued its statement on November 21.

unknowns.zh: 聲明未公布新增跨境合作對象、工業材料的再生含量門檻或實施日期。
unknowns.en: The statement gave no new cross-border partners, industrial recycled-content thresholds or effective dates.

ceoView.zh: 工業材料量測及回收設備商會想確認，政策公布後是否會訂出再生含量、材料追溯或檢驗規格。這次聲明尚未提供認證條件或執行日期。
ceoView.en: Industrial material testing and recycling equipment suppliers would ask whether follow-on rules specify recycled content, traceability or testing. The statement does not identify qualification conditions or implementation dates.

question.zh: 亞力的訂單金額涵蓋哪些市場？
question.en: Which markets does Allis’s backlog cover?

text.zh: 公司在法說會提到半導體擴廠、資料中心和台電工程。現有資料未分列各類訂單金額、驗收或收入認列時程。
text.en: The briefing cited fab expansion, data centers and Taipower projects. Available disclosures do not break out order values, acceptance or revenue recognition by segment.

question.zh: 柔佛代管聲明回答了哪些問題？
question.en: What does the Johor colocation statement establish?

text.zh: YTL 說明其提供空間、供電、冷卻及連線，並說明公司對新規適用範圍的看法。公開資料未見主管機關認定。
text.en: YTL identified space, power, cooling and connectivity as its services and gave its interpretation of the rule. No regulatory determination was located.

question.zh: 南寶披露的是哪個產品階段？
question.en: Which product milestone did Nan Pao disclose?

text.zh: 南寶表示已供應半導體用膠。公司把先進封裝膠材列為拓展目標，未公開認證和出貨數字。
text.en: Nan Pao reported shipments of semiconductor adhesives. It listed advanced packaging adhesives as a development target, with no disclosed qualification or shipment counts.

title.zh: 先前公布的產能合作與展會發布
title.en: Previously announced capacity and exhibition releases

text.zh: 輝達與台灣廠商先前宣布的產能合作及群聯 11 月 17 日 SC26 儲存發布，近期報導以重述原公告為主。
text.en: Recent coverage largely recapped the previously announced NVIDIA capacity agreements and Phison’s November 17 storage announcement at SC26.

verificationNote.zh: 亞力在手訂單金額依媒體引述的法說資訊。立碁送樣進度為媒體報導，客戶端驗證結果尚未公開。YTL 對新規適用範圍的說明為公司立場。
verificationNote.en: Allis’s backlog figure comes from media coverage of its briefing. Ligitek’s sampling status was reported by the press and customer qualification results remain undisclosed. YTL’s assessment of the new rule reflects the company’s position.
